Eloise Chen: Hi team! Eloise here, starting today on eng-runtime. Quick check-in: laptop arrived, trying to enroll in MDM. Any gotchas for Apple Silicon? Also where do I request a building badge and is there a slack intro template I should use? :wave:

Nikhil (DevEx): welcome Eloise!! For M1/M2 it's mostly the same. Run the profile installer and then "Repair MDM" if JAMF gets stuck. Quick commands:
```bash
sudo profiles install /var/tmp/redwood-mdm.mobileconfig
sudo jamf recon || true
```
If it hangs, ping me and I'll trigger a reprovision. Badge requests go through People Ops (see link in #new-hires pinned).

onboard-bot: New hire account provisioned: Eloise Chen. AD groups: engineers, eng-runtime. Onboarding checklist: https://intranet.redwood.com/onboarding/eloise_chen. Slack intro template copied to your DM.

Jenna (People Ops): Hi Eloise 1 welcome! Badge request submitted, expect pickup instructions by EOD. We left a welcome kit (stickers + mug) on your desk and mailed a kit to your home (tracking: 1Z111AA10123456700). We also added you to the "new hires lunch" for Friday.

Sam Ortiz: hey Eloise 1 I'm on eng-runtime too. First-week task is tiny: add a small comment block in runtime/README linking to the perf-playground so you get the repo + CI flow. PR usually takes 10-15 mins. Want to pair this afternoon?

Alex Rivera: quick intro 1 I'm your manager. Welcome! 1:1 tomorrow at 10am PT to go over goals. Also fun fact thread: post one unexpected hobby so people can say hi. I'll start: I make sourdough. :bread:

Eloise Chen: thanks all! pairing at 4pm PT works for me @Sam. Fun fact: I used to code a tiny game in BASIC as a kid and still have the source on a floppy somewhere :laughing:. Looking forward to meeting everyone in person.

Nikhil (DevEx): invite dropped for 4pm PT, zoom in #calendar. See you then :slightly_smiling_face:
